random_forest.name: Random Forest Regressor
random_forest.description: Combines 100 decision trees to capture complex non-linear weather interactions with high accuracy.

linear_regression.name: Linear Regression
linear_regression.description: Learns transparent mathematical coefficients for each weather factor (Temp, Humidity, Wind). Very easy to read and explain.

decision_tree.name: Decision Tree Regressor
decision_tree.description: Splits weather data into human-readable if/else thresholds (e.g., low wind + high humidity = higher AQI).
